steps.title: A deep clone that keeps the shape
steps.text: `cloneDeep(source)` copies the nested objects and arrays and keeps the cycle. Things it does not copy, such as the DOM element and the function, stay shared with the original.
steps.textZh: `cloneDeep(source)` 复制了嵌套的对象和数组，并保留了循环引用。它不复制的东西，比如 DOM 元素和函数，仍和原对象共用。

watch.label: copy.circleRef === copy
watch.value: (() => { const copy = cloneDeep(source); return copy.circleRef === copy; })()

steps.title: structuredClone refuses
steps.text: The built-in `structuredClone` keeps cycles too, but it cannot copy DOM nodes or functions, so it throws a `DataCloneError` on this object.
steps.textZh: 内置的 `structuredClone` 也能保留循环引用，但它不能复制 DOM 节点和函数，所以在这个对象上会抛出 `DataCloneError`。

action.run: try { structuredClone(source) } catch (error) { console.log('structuredClone(source) threw a', error.name) }

steps.title: Plain data is fine
steps.text: On plain data, `structuredClone` keeps the cycle and gives back a real `Date`.
steps.textZh: 对纯数据，`structuredClone` 会保留循环引用，还会还原出真正的 `Date`。

action.run: const plain = { list: [1, 2], when: new Date(0) }; plain.self = plain; const copy = structuredClone(plain); console.log('cycle kept:', copy.self === copy, '| date is a Date:', copy.when instanceof Date)

steps.expectConsole: cycle kept: true | date is a Date: true
